# Lunar Client Support

> > Official support and troubleshooting knowledge base for Lunar Client, a performance-enhancing Minecraft client by Moonsworth.

This support center provides comprehensive guides for resolving technical issues with Lunar Client across Windows platforms, including graphics configuration (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel), launch errors, and system diagnostics. Users can access troubleshooting articles, create support tickets, and find solutions for common problems related to GPU selection, native extraction failures, and performance optimization.

## Key Topics

- Lunar Client
- Moonsworth
- Minecraft
- Windows troubleshooting
- GPU configuration (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel)
- Integrated vs dedicated graphics
- Support tickets
- Launch errors
- Performance optimization
- Lunar+
- Java runtime issues
- System diagnostics (dxdiag)
- Graphics driver updates
- Native extraction failures

## Getting Started & Support

- [Support : Lunar Client](https://support.lunarclient.com/): Lunar Client support homepage and knowledge base center
- [Solutions : Lunar Client](https://support.lunarclient.com/support/solutions): Browse all support solutions and troubleshooting guides
- [Create a Support Ticket : Lunar Client](https://support.lunarclient.com/support/solutions/articles/60000719252-how-to-create-a-support-ticket): Guide to creating support tickets for Lunar Client assistance

## Graphics & Performance Troubleshooting

- [Lunar Client using Integrated Graphics : Lunar Client](https://support.lunarclient.com/support/solutions/articles/60000714758-lunar-client-using-integrated-graphics): Fix Lunar Client using integrated GPU instead of dedicated graphics
- [Pixel Format Launch Fail : Lunar Client](https://support.lunarclient.com/support/solutions/articles/60000715125-pixel-format-launch-fail): Resolve pixel format launch errors via graphics driver updates

## Launch & Installation Issues

- [Failed to Extract Natives : Lunar Client](https://support.lunarclient.com/support/solutions/articles/60000714503-failed-to-extract-natives): Fix failed to extract natives error on Windows launch
